themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their rhetoric and policy proposals in response to recent migration crises, particularly in Spain's Ceuta and Italy. These parties are framing migration as a national security threat and demanding immediate government action, often leveraging the issue for electoral advantage.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands immediate government action on Ceuta's migration crisis, proposing measures like deportations and border closures.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: PM Meloni reaffirms continued deportations of irregular migrants, emphasizing border security and rule enforcement.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes government handling of migration, advocating for stricter border controls and deportation policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Calls for stricter immigration policies, criticizing government's handling of migration crises.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage campaigns on anti-immigration policies, proposing an 'Australia-style' border policy.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration policies, criticizing government's handling of migration issues.
